projects.title: PulseSync — Real-Time Collaborative Code & Incident Workspace
projects.subtitle: Low-latency multi-room engineering collaboration platform
projects.overview: A full-stack collaborative workspace engineered with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Redis Pub/Sub. Handles multi-room state synchronization, role-based workspace permissions, and indexed revision snapshots with containerized deployment.
highlights: Architected a stateful WebSocket gateway backed by Redis Pub/Sub to synchronize live edits and presence across concurrent rooms with sub-35ms broadcast latency.
Implemented stateless JWT access + rotating refresh token auth with RBAC workspace permissions and rate-limited API endpoints.
Designed indexed MongoDB & revision snapshot schemas, cutting historical diff query latency significantly.
Containerized multi-service builds with Docker Compose and automated CI checks plus reverse-proxy deployment.

projects.title: FinLedger — High-Throughput Expense & Settlement Engine
projects.subtitle: Double-entry ledger API with idempotent payment workflows
projects.overview: An ACID-compliant financial ledger and expense settlement platform featuring idempotency-key request guards, strict schema validation, cursor-based pagination, and S3 receipt storage.
highlights: Built an ACID-compliant double-entry ledger using serializable database transactions and idempotency keys to prevent duplicate settlement writes under retry storms.
Secured user accounts with bcrypt password hashing, HTTP-only cookie sessions, and strict Zod request validation middleware.
Added cursor-based pagination and Redis query caching on analytics endpoints for fast, predictable API response times.
Deployed frontend and backend pipelines with S3 receipt storage, automated database migrations, and health-checked rollouts.

projects.title: CodeJudge — Sandboxed Online Execution & Contest Platform
projects.subtitle: Isolated container runner for timed coding assessments
projects.overview: An isolated code execution and assessment engine that decouples submission intake via BullMQ + Redis worker queues and executes untrusted code inside resource-capped, non-root Docker containers.
highlights: Decoupled submission intake from execution using a BullMQ + Redis worker queue that schedules untrusted code inside memory- and CPU-capped Docker sandboxes.
Enforced strict execution timeouts, read-only root filesystems, and non-root container isolation to eliminate host-escape vectors.
Modeled test-case verdicts, problem metadata, and live leaderboard aggregations in MongoDB with compound indexing.
Implemented live Server-Sent Events (SSE) status streaming to React clients so verdicts update immediately without polling overhead.
